description: A human gene, either a protein-coding gene from NCBI Entrez Gene or a microRNA gene annotated with miRBase precursor (stem-loop) identity. These are disjoint populations. All use NCBI Gene identifiers. Some genes also carry a ChEMBL target cross-reference from UniProt human ID-mapping data. Historical genes that no longer qualify for their source population may remain with obsolete set to true.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: NCBI Gene identifier as a full prefixed CURIE (e.g. NCBIGene:672).

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: Official gene symbol from Entrez Gene (e.g. BRCA1), including for microRNA genes.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: The originating source: "Entrez Gene" for protein-coding genes or "miRBase" for microRNA genes. UniProt Human ID Mapping is not recorded in this list.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: When this gene was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Homo sapiens (tax_id == 9606) records with type_of_gene == "protein-coding" in NCBI Entrez Gene.
source_contributions.description: Protein-coding human gene records from NCBI's Entrez Gene database. Each node is one gene identified by its NCBI Gene ID, carrying the official gene symbol, a short functional description, chromosomal location, alternate symbols, and cross-references to other gene and identifier databases.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Short functional description of the gene.
properties.notes: Omit property entirely when source value is `-`

properties.name: chromosome
properties.description: Chromosomal location of the gene (e.g. 17, X, MT).
properties.notes: Omit property entirely when source value is `-`

properties.name: synonyms
properties.description: Alternate gene symbols for this gene.
properties.notes: Store empty list `[]` when source value is `-`

properties.name: xrefs
properties.description: Cross-references to other databases (e.g. MIM, HGNC, Ensembl, AllianceGenome), stored as full prefixed identifier strings exactly as given by the source.
properties.notes: Omit property entirely when source value is `-`

properties.name: ensembl
properties.description: Ensembl gene identifier for this gene, stored without a prefix (e.g. ENSG00000121410); also available in prefixed form within xrefs.
properties.notes: Store empty string `""` when no Ensembl entry present in `dbXrefs`

properties.name: license
properties.description: Data-usage license for this gene record. Always "CC0 1.0".

source_contributions.scope: Human (tax_id == 9606) Entrez Gene ncRNA records carrying a miRBase precursor cross-reference represented in the miRBase precursor catalog. Precursors without a qualifying Entrez Gene record are not represented. Mature microRNA products are outside this annotation scope.
source_contributions.description: Human microRNA genes with their Entrez Gene identity and miRBase precursor accession and name. These genes have no description, chromosome, synonyms, xrefs, ensembl, or license properties from this source.

properties.name: mirbase_accession
properties.description: Accession of the gene's miRBase precursor (stem-loop) microRNA (e.g. MI0000060).

properties.name: mirbase_name
properties.description: Human-readable name of the gene's miRBase precursor microRNA (e.g. hsa-let-7a-1).

source_contributions.scope: Human gene records with ChEMBL target cross-references supported by primary human UniProt accessions in the human ID-mapping data. Isoform-suffixed accessions are excluded. Only one ChEMBL identifier is represented per gene, even where several mappings exist.
source_contributions.description: ChEMBL target cross-reference associated with an NCBI Gene ID through the UniProt human ID-mapping data.

properties.name: chembl_id
properties.description: ChEMBL target identifier associated with this gene (e.g. CHEMBL3710403).
properties.notes: Absent from node entirely if no ChEMBL mapping resolves to this Gene; never null or empty string
